description: This PHP source file defines a class RegistrationEmployeeActivationEventProcessor which extends AbstractRegistrationEventProcessor. The class is part of the OrangeHRM project and handles processing registration events related to employee activation, specifically counting active employees and determining if an event should be saved based on employee count changes.

classes.name: RegistrationEmployeeActivationEventProcessor
classes.description: A class that processes registration events related to employee activation, providing methods to get event type, data, and whether the event should be saved based on active employee counts.

methods.name: getEventType
methods.description: Returns a constant indicating the type of registration event, specifically active employee count.

methods.name: getEventData
methods.description: Gathers and returns data related to current active employees for the registration event.

methods.name: getEventToBeSavedOrNot
methods.description: Determines whether the current event should be saved based on whether the employee count meets certain change thresholds.
